characterization_methods.key_findings: A15 retains elongated B2 stringer bands and URE-γ pancake grains; fine IG-B2 needles and coarse GB-B2 particles are visible at higher magnification
characterization_methods.purpose: Observe B2 morphologies (stringer bands, IG-B2, GB-B2) and URE-γ in annealed A15
characterization_methods.technique: FESEM (field emission gun scanning electron microscopy)

characterization_methods.key_findings: A15 fracture surface shows void nucleation and B2 stringer features
characterization_methods.purpose: Fracture analysis of the tensile gauge

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: 100 kN Instron 5982 with 10 mm gauge extensometer
characterization_methods.key_findings: A15 tensile strength higher than A10; elongation ~16%; toughness 0.85 kJ/mol (117.8 J/cm³)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; ASTM E8; gauge length 12.5 mm; gauge width 3 mm; thickness 2 mm; 1 mm/min crosshead velocity; RD
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure strength, ductility and absorbed energy before fracture

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: multicomponent Fe-10Al-15Mn-0.8C-5Ni wt% alloy; pseudo-binary vs C; annealing marker at 900 °C
computational_details.simulation_method: thermodynamic CALPHAD calculation (pseudo-binary phase diagram; phase fraction and solute partitioning vs temperature)
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: outputs consistent with Ref. [15] for the same alloy composition

defect_interactions.interaction_type: B2 stringer band de-cohesion / void nucleation
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Macrovoids nucleate inside B2 stringer bands; coalescence triggers crack initiation; B2 stringer band segments debond along the loading axis; A15 fracture surface annotated 'void nucleation' and 'B2 stringer'.

interfaces.phase_evolution: Annealing at 900 °C causes static recrystallization of B2 stringer bands into a bamboo-like structure; IG-B2 and GB-B2 precipitate in addition to the retained B2 stringer bands.

phase_interfaces.coherence: Intragranular B2 (BCC) precipitation in FCC γ is described as difficult through high coherency strain or activation energy barrier; GB-B2 forms at γ grain boundaries with enhanced solute flux.

processing_steps.atmosphere: 10^-5 mbar pressure, backfilled with an argon gas atmosphere
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Remelted 5–6 times inside the arc melter (AM500-Edmund Buhler GmbH, Germany) without breaking vacuum for better elemental intermixing.
Nine passes at 1050 °C in a 75-ton rolling mill until finish rolling temperature of 900 °C.
Annealing of the standard-route CR sheet; sample denoted A15.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: 100 kN Instron 5982 with 10 mm gauge extensometer
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: gauge length 12.5 mm; gauge width 3 mm; thickness 2 mm; rolling direction (RD)

elongation.uncertainty: approximate, read from Figure 5a engineering stress-strain curve

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: A15 (blue) engineering stress-strain curve shown in Figure 5a; lower flow stress than A5/HR, extends to roughly 16% strain

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: URE-γ grains coarse and elongated along prior RD (pancake structure); RE-γ grain size increases with annealing time

phases_present.morphology: URE-γ pancake-shaped grains elongated along prior RD plus recrystallized RE-γ grains
Three morphologies: B2 stringer bands (elongated lamellar along RD), IG-B2 (needle-like intragranular), GB-B2 (coarse irregular intergranular)

precipitates.distribution: Fine needle-like intragranular particles, nucleated at shear bands within URE-γ; present in A15 at higher magnification
Coarse, irregular/blocky particles located on grain boundaries
Elongated lamellar bands aligned along the prior rolling direction

structures.overall_structure: Annealed (900 °C / 15 min, water-quenched) austenitic γ microstructure retaining three B2 morphologies: elongated B2 stringer bands along the prior rolling direction, fine needle-like intragranular IG-B2, and coarse irregular intergranular GB-B2; URE-γ pancake grains and RE-γ grains are present.

unmapped_findings: Precipitation strengthening (Ashby-Orowan, eq. 1) reported for the annealed alloy system, not specifically A15: IG-B2 (0.29 μm, 1.1%) in RE-γ (Figure 3a) gives 23 MPa; IG-B2 (0.2 μm, 2.6%) in URE-γ gives 43 MPa; total IG-B2 strengthening = 66 MPa (b0025-b0026, b0040).

Interrupted-tensile TEM/EBSD of 'A15' at engineering strain e = 0.05 (Figure 7c-e): higher dislocation density in γ than in B2; GND localization at γ/B2 interfaces. Route attribution ambiguous - Figure 7 appears in the modified-HR discussion, so this 'A15' may be the modified-route A15 rather than the standard-route A15.

B2 stringer bands reported present up to 16% in the annealed sample microstructure (b0041); the modified route reduced stringer band fraction from 16% to 11% (b0032). No per-sample stringer fraction is given for standard-route A15.

The abstract-level final outcome (nearly 1 GPa yield strength, 28% total elongation, >1.7 kJ/mol or 238.4 J/cm^3 toughness) refers to the improved modified-route steel, not to the standard-route A15 sample.

A15 fracture surface (Figure 4 upper panel) is annotated 'void nucleation' and 'B2 stringer', consistent with the general finding that macrovoids nucleate inside B2 stringer bands and cause premature failure (b0030, b0043).
